_note: Written after looking at every view and BEFORE any grading. Not changed afterwards. Band = what a fair boss would give, 8 to 15 wide. order = [higher, lower] pairs that must hold.

mug/m1_excellent.why: The same mug from every angle, leaner than the goal; only the facet count differs.

mug/m2_good_slips.why: Right mug; a slightly taller straight body, a smaller handle and lighter coffee are small things.

mug/m3_mediocre.why: Recognisably the mug with all its parts, but squat and wide with a chunky ring handle and a small saucer.

mug/m4_poor.why: A blue cylinder with a box handle: the idea of a mug, missing the saucer and coffee and the round handle.

mug/m5_handle_left.why: Exactly the same mug turned half round; a boss would accept it, at most a small charge for facing.

mug/m6_handle_floating.why: Everything right except one obvious flaw: the handle hangs in the air off the side.

mug/m7_no_saucer.why: One obvious part missing: the saucer; the mug itself is perfect.

mug/m8_half_height.why: Badly distorted: a squat bowl at half the height with a flattened handle.

mug/x1_mug_extruded_outline.why: A blue block with a slab handle; right only from straight in front.

rocket/r1_excellent.why: The same rocket from every angle, slightly leaner.

rocket/r2_good_slips.why: Right rocket; a shorter nose with a thin gap, an orange band and no window are small to moderate slips.

rocket/r3_mediocre.why: A rocket with fins and nozzle, but fat, short, tall-nosed and with small fins; no band or window.

rocket/r4_poor.why: A white tube with a red cone: the idea, but no fins, nozzle, band or window.

rocket/r5_fins_45.why: Identical except the fins sit diagonally to the window; noticed only by comparing.

rocket/r6_three_fins.why: Right rocket with one obvious difference: three fins instead of four.

rocket/r7_no_nose.why: The nose cone, the most recognisable part, is missing; the rest is perfect.

rocket/x2_rocket_cube_cloud.why: A blocky voxel rocket, recognisable but badly distorted, made of 666 meshes and 14 times the triangles.

rocket/x3_rocket_billboard.why: Two crossed flat grey cut-outs: no volume, no colours.

snowman/s1_excellent.why: The same snowman from every angle, slightly leaner.

snowman/s2_good_slips.why: Right snowman; short arms, a small gap under the head, a red nose and two buttons are small slips.

snowman/s3_mediocre.why: All the main parts but clumsy: three nearly equal balls, a huge hat, arms straight out, no eyes.

snowman/s4_poor.why: Three balls and a nose: a snowman, but no hat, arms, eyes or buttons.

snowman/s5_hat_beside.why: One obvious flaw: the hat floats beside the head.

snowman/s6_arms_raised.why: The same snowman with its arms posed up instead of out; one visible difference.

snowman/s7_sunk.why: Squashed: the balls sink deep into each other, so it is noticeably shorter and squat.

snowman/s8_floating.why: Everything right but the balls float apart with visible gaps; one obvious construction flaw.

snowman/x4_snowman_block.why: A white box: nothing of a snowman.

snowman/x5_snowman_cutout.why: Two crossed flat cut-outs: right from straight in front, paper-thin otherwise, no nose or face.

bookshelf/b1_excellent.why: The same bookshelf, book heights a centimetre off; smaller code.

bookshelf/b2_five_books.why: Right shelf but three of the eight books missing, leaving visible gaps.

bookshelf/b3_books_swapped.why: Two books swapped; found only by flipping between the two.

bookshelf/b4_no_back.why: One big obvious part missing: the back panel, so it is see-through.

bookshelf/b5_mediocre.why: A bookshelf, but deep and chunky, shelves at the wrong heights, eight identical brown books in one row.

bookshelf/b6_poor.why: An empty frame: the outline of a bookshelf with no shelves, back or books.

bookshelf/b7_good_slips.why: Right shelf, but the upper shelf board is missing, two books are off-colour and the top lifts slightly.

bookshelf/b8_shallow.why: Right from the front, but less than half the depth: clearly thin from the side and above.

bookshelf/x6_bookshelf_block.why: A wooden box of the right size: from behind it matches, but no shelves or books.

bookshelf/x7_bookshelf_painted_block.why: A box with a picture of a bookshelf on its front; flat from every other angle, and 100 times the triangles.

bicycle/k2_good_slips.why: Right bicycle; slightly small wheels, a lifted seat and a black handlebar are small slips.

bicycle/k3_mediocre.why: Recognisably a bicycle but crude: small wheels, fat tubes at wrong angles, no seat stay or chainring.

bicycle/k4_poor.why: Two wheels and a bar: the idea only.

bicycle/k5_disc_wheels.why: Right frame, but solid black discs instead of tyres: a big visible difference.

bicycle/k6_bar_rotated.why: Identical except the handlebar runs along the bike instead of across it.

bicycle/k7_bloat.why: The perfect shape built with about 24 times the triangles: many times heavier than needed.

bicycle/k8_flattened.why: Right from the side, but a flat sheet: handlebar and chainring offset gone, tyres paper-thin.

bicycle/x8_bicycle_boxes.why: Square slabs for wheels and a slab for the frame: blocky caricature in the right colours.
